provenance.note: Authored directly from a /grill-with-docs interview (2026-07-08, 13 locked decisions) plus three Codex research reports (Ontology-Playground survey, beep repo capability inventory, graph rendering performance landscape) saved verbatim under research/. Amended same day after a second grilling round (9 locked decisions) informed by two Codex reports on the ontosphere reference repo (Apache-2.0): SHACL+verified repairs, session graph partitions, typed worker protocol, ABox/TBox view modes, fold levels/clustering, agent-ready ops, PROV-O + VoID/DCAT exports, ontoauthor-mat fixtures; phases restructured P0-P6.

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until this goal's work ships as PRs driven to mergeable via /yeet (bun run beep yeet: repair -> verify -> publish --pr -> monitor); each phase lands through yeet and P6's PR must be mergeable.

phases.name: Bootstrap
phases.exit: Branch from fresh origin/main; packet sources confirmed; capability-report facts re-verified or drift recorded.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.exit: ontology slice (domain+use-cases+server) and drivers/n3 land with partitioned session design and Effect-Schema worker protocol; ontoauthor-mat + pizza/FOAF fixtures ported; direct fixture round-trip by rdf-canonize fingerprint passed in sandbox; host must run install and Vitest slice tests.

phases.name: Explorer + Editor
phases.exit: client + ui packages landed with sidecar RPCs, atom client state, workbench UI, real batch deltas, shared ABox/TBox classification/search, pizza tutorial typed ops, change-log panel, fixed tooltip button markup, and prefix-preserving Turtle save behavior; live proof covered core flows, and host must rerun bun-backed tests plus the running desktop author-edit-save proof.

phases.name: Visualizer
phases.exit: drivers/cosmos viewport with worker projection, incremental graph deltas, focus-neighborhood, fold levels L0-L3 with clustering, halo light-editing gestures, pinned-node layouts, sigma fallback preservation, and folded worker-backed spike contract implemented locally; host must rerun the synthetic 100k-element ontology interactive proof on webkitgtk with folds active. Evidence: history/2026-07-09-p3-visualizer.md.

phases.name: SPARQL + Reasoning
phases.exit: drivers/oxigraph implements the @beep/semantic-web SPARQL contract; query panel executes SELECT/CONSTRUCT with safeguards UX; inferred-view toggle shows closure/type/disjointness signals under the invalidation discipline; local quality gates and node-backed Vitest proof passed, with host install/browser proof still required. Evidence: history/2026-07-09-p4-sparql-reasoning.md.

phases.name: Validation + Provenance
phases.exit: drivers/shacl implements the @beep/semantic-web SHACL contract; validation runs over asserted plus inferred graphs; verified repair proposals are typed undoable change operations; validation metrics, focus-node navigation, PROV-O journal export, and VoID/DCAT dataset export are implemented. Local package checks and formatting passed; host must verify npm registry pins, install, rerun tests, and complete browser acceptance. Evidence: history/2026-07-09-p5-validation-provenance.md.

phases.name: Harden + Close
phases.exit: Structural Turtle interop evidence, real PROV-O subset round-trip, ontoauthor-mat executable status suite, node-side projection benchmark, disambiguation notes, docs, and acceptance checklist recorded in history/2026-07-09-p6-harden-close.md. Host must run ROBOT/Protege, GUI/Tauri proof, /reflect plus reflection lint, Yeet closeout, and resolve or explicitly defer remaining OWL DL competency gaps before final close.
